label: Diagram 9.2
caption: Diagram 9.2 Pipes penetrating fire-separating elements
description: This is a section drawing with a green footer reading "Diagram 9.2 Pipes penetrating fire-separating elements" and the text "See para 9.5" in the top left. In the centre, a horizontal light-grey element (the pipe and sleeve) passes through a vertical grey fire-separating element, with a green block on each face of the horizontal element at the fire-separating element. The horizontal element is dimensioned "≥ 1000mm" to the left of the fire-separating element and "≥ 1000mm" to the right of it. The label "Fire-separating element" has a leader line to the vertical grey member. The label "Pipe specification (b)" points to a marked point on the horizontal element to the left of the fire-separating element; "Fire-stopping" points to the lower green block; and "Sleeve (or pipe) of specification (a) to be in contact with pipe" points to a marked point on the horizontal element to the right of the fire-separating element. On the right, a NOTES block lists: 1. Make the opening in the fire-separating element as small as possible and provide fire-stopping between pipe and fire-separating element. 2. See Table 9.1 for materials specification. 3. The sleeve should be class A1 rated.
